scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && electron scripts/ui-smoke.cjs && electron scripts/sync-history-smoke.cjs

extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Mote records screenshots only while you enable capture, applies your privacy filters locally, then uploads them to your own central node. The microphone and system-audio permission is also used only while you start a meeting recording.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Mote records the microphone only while you explicitly start a local meeting recording. The audio stays on this Mac until you end the meeting and is then uploaded to your own central node for transcription.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Read selected calendars for personal context. With your explicit authorization, create, update or cancel events only within the authorized device, existing calendars and source scope; mark completion in Mote and retain Mote source references. Actions outside that scope require explicit confirmation.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Read selected calendars for personal context. With your explicit authorization, create, update or cancel events only within the authorized device, existing calendars and source scope; mark completion in Mote and retain Mote source references. Actions outside that scope require explicit confirmation.
